text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging delivery failure detected for service=notify-proxy, destination=pagerduty, error=503 Service Unavailable. Suppression flagged: header-mismatch. Recent pages 12m ago were dropped.

jess (oncall): saw the alert, I'm on it. Do we have any customer-facing pages?

lia (support): we have 2 customers reporting lack of incident notifications from our status page in the last 20m. They're not seeing PD pages.

maria: looks like notify-proxy started returning 503 on webhook fanout to pagerduty. Headers are getting trimmed by our proxy layer (X-Routing-Id truncated). PD rejects -> our suppressor thinks it's duplicate and squelches.

sam: can someone try a manual webhook replay to PD from the staging trigger to confirm flow? cmd I use: 
```
curl -X POST https://notify.internal/replay -H "Authorization: Bearer $REPLAY" -d '{"alert_id":"test-123"}'
```

jess (oncall): running replay now.

incident-bot: replay request accepted, job=job-884, status=queued.

jess (oncall): replay got 503 from notify-proxy as well, same header-trim log: `WARN header length trim for X-Routing-Id`

dave (eng-runtime): that trimming change slipped in last config deploy at 03:07 UTC, PR #4876. It was intended to limit header size for upstreams but we accidentally normalized header keys. Rolling back the header normalization should fix it.

maria: rollback queued. I'll push a hotfix to disable normalization on the notify-proxy path. ETA ~10m.

lia (support): I'll notify the two impacted customers and tell them we're investigating; advise manual alerting if needed.

jess (oncall): manual paging enabled for critical escalation for next 30m. tagging @pagerduty-support in case of retries needed.

incident-bot: rollback started by maria, deploy id=deploy-1723, target=notify-proxy, strategy=hotfix.

sam: adding a quick runbook note: if notify-proxy 503 -> check header-trim toggle via `/etc/notify/proxy.conf` and run `systemctl restart notify-proxy` after toggling.

maria: hotfix applied and restarted, service reports healthy. running a replay test.

incident-bot: replay job job-884 -> PD delivery status=200 OK.

jess (oncall): PD pages are flowing again. Confirmed with two synthetic pages.

lia (support): customers confirmed they received the manual notification, will follow up with a post-incident note.

dave (eng-runtime): root cause: header normalization change in PR #4876 removed X-Routing-Id on long headers, which caused our duplicate-detection suppressor to think events were replays and drop them. We'll add a guard in the suppressor to be tolerant of missing routing id for 5m after deploys.

maria: creating a patch and test to prevent future accidental header normalization on critical webhook paths. PR linked in retro.

jess (oncall): thanks everyone. I'll file the incident ticket and tag for a 30-min retro in incidents-next. If anything else pops up ping on this thread. :thumbsup:

sam: note for SLOs — tokenized delivery latency spiked but no ingestion loss. We should capture the metrics window 02:55-03:15 UTC for postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident resolved. severity=SEV3 -> downgraded. manual pages enabled->disabled.

lia (support): drafting customer-facing update now.

jess (oncall): closing thread after retro. Good catch on the header change.
